documents.title: AMWA BCP-007 NMOS Transport Mappings: Overview
documents.text: AMWA BCP-007 NMOS Transport Mappings: Overview AMWA BCP-007 NMOS Transport Mappings: Overview Introduction Overview - [Work In Progress] AMWA NMOS Transport Mappings Skip to content AMWA BCP-007 NMOS Transport Mappings: Overview (c) AMWA 2023, CC Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-ND 4.0) Introduction AMWA IS-04/05 and the other NMOS Specifications were originally mostly used in ST 2110 RTP environments, but have always been capable of extension to other streaming transports. BCP-007 is an extensible series of mappings specifying how to use NMOS for individual transports. BCP-007 is complemented by the BCP-006 series of format mappings. For details of the current set of mappings see the list of BCPs on the main NMOS page.

documents.text: [Work In Progress] AMWA NMOS Transport Mappings [Work In Progress] AMWA NMOS Transport Mappings What does the series do? Why does it matter? What are the mappings? Getting started [Work In Progress] AMWA NMOS Transport Mappings - [Work In Progress] AMWA NMOS Transport Mappings Skip to content [Work In Progress] AMWA NMOS Transport Mappings This repository holds the source for this Specification, part of the family of Networked Media Open Specifications from the Advanced Media Workflow Association What does the series do? The BCP-007 series of AMWA Best Common Practices define how to connect Endpoints using AMWA IS-04 and IS-05 for various transports including: Specification of the resources and attributes used for the format. Requirements for the Transport File (such as SDP). Examples. Why does it matter? The individual mapping BCPs ensure consistency between implementations offering NMOS for each stream transport. Bringing these together in the BCP-007 series helps provide consistency between the individual mappings and provides an index of mappings. What are the mappings? BCP-007-01: NMOS With NDI BCP-007-02: NMOS Support for IPMX/USB BCP-007-03: NMOS Support for MXL Getting started Choose the mapping for the transport being integrated: BCP-007-01 for NDI BCP-007-02 for IPMX/USB BCP-007-03 for MXL There is more information about the NMOS Specifications and their GitHub repos at https://specs.amwa.tv/nmos .
